symptom: An export mapping value bound to an AutoNumber attribute or to the system member createdDate was stored as DataTypes$StringType; mx check reported CE0227 (attribute type not compatible with schema data type 'String') and CE5015 per element. Integer, DateTime and Boolean attributes were fine.
cause: Two fall-throughs to the String default: the writer's type switch had no AutoNumber case, and the resolver looked only in the entity's attribute list, which never holds createdDate/changedDate.
fix: AutoNumber maps to DataTypes$IntegerType / XmlPrimitiveType Integer; createdDate and changedDate resolve to DateTime (systemMemberTypeOr). Shared by import and export mappings.
insight: A type switch with a String default is a silent-wrong-write generator: every attribute type it forgets becomes String, which serializes cleanly and only mxbuild objects. Enumerate the domain's type names against the switch (here AutoNumber was the only scalar missing) rather than waiting for each one to be reported.
test: mdl/backend/modelsdk/mapping_value_type_2603_test.go, mdl/executor/mapping_value_type_2603_test.go (control: unknown member stays String); both failed before. Live 11.12.6: the issue's mapping gave CE0227 x2 + CE5015 before, 0 errors after.
